description: Your seismic monitoring network has been experiencing elevated false-alarm rates over the past week. The network operator suspects that one of the five GE-network stations (TOLI, GSI, KWP, SANI, BKB) is producing unreliable data that is contaminating the automatic event detection pipeline. Your task is to investigate and resolve this issue: identify which station is producing anomalous data by inspecting waveform quality across all stations, disable the problematic station's processing module bindings so it no longer feeds into automatic detection, and write an operator log entry to /home/ga/Desktop/station_anomaly_report.txt documenting which station was identified as problematic, what symptoms you observed, and what corrective action you took.
